KB_Config.Description: System Memory Usage Monitoring - Detects unusual memory consumption patterns

Query_Elastic.query: FROM .ds-kibana_sample_data_logs-* | WHERE @timestamp >= '2025-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' AND @timestamp < '2025-11-01T00:00:00.000Z' | EVAL es_timestamp = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, @timestamp) | STATS avg_memory_mb = AVG(machine.ram) / 1048576 BY es_timestamp | SORT es_timestamp
